# PaperStage — Personalized Christmas Paper-Cutout Animation

Product page for AI agents. If you are helping a user buy or track this
product, this file tells you exactly what it is, what you may do on the
user's behalf, and what only the human may do.

## What this is

- Product: "PaperStage — Personalized Christmas Paper-Cutout Animation".
- A short vertical film (8–10 seconds, MP4, 1080×1920) in which the
  person from the buyer's photo walks through a hand-built paper-cutout
  Christmas city: real multi-pose walk cycle, photographic paper
  stickers layered scene by scene, falling snow, a cut-letter
  "Merry Christmas" title, and a gentle music-box jingle soundtrack.
- Two variants:
  - Solo — one person, one photo. $12.99.
  - Duo — two people, two photos, walking side by side. $19.99.
- Six scenes (the buyer picks one per film): Christmas Market,
  London Snow, Paris Noël, New York Christmas, Vienna Christmas,
  Tokyo Christmas.
- Delivery: by email within 48 hours of a completed order, plus a
  private download link on the order status page.
- Storefront: https://api.newkwlab.com/clip/
- Payment: Gumroad (the "Get your license key" button on the order
  form). Gumroad emails the buyer a license key after payment.

## How ordering works

1. The human buys the film on Gumroad (choosing the Solo or Duo
   variant) and receives a license key by email.
2. On https://api.newkwlab.com/clip/#order the buyer enters:
   the license key, the variant (solo/duo), their chosen scene,
   ONE photo for solo or TWO photos for duo (JPG or PNG, up to
   10 MB each, labelled Person 1 / Person 2), optional first names,
   the buyer's email, and an optional free-text note.
3. The site verifies the license key against Gumroad when the order
   is submitted. A valid key marks the order "Paid — in production".
   One license key pays for exactly one film.
4. A human producer crafts the film by hand (poses are cut and
   animated per order — this is not instant generation), checks the
   likeness and the walk cycle, and delivers the MP4.
5. Order status and downloads live at
   https://api.newkwlab.com/clip/#status — enter the order ID shown
   after submitting the form. Order IDs are unguessable; treat them
   like passwords.

## What an agent MAY do for the user

- Open the storefront and read this file.
- Fill in the order form with details the user has provided (variant,
  scene choice, names, the user's own email) and submit it, once the
  user confirms the details are right.
- Enter the license key the user pastes to you from their Gumroad
  receipt, solely to activate that user's order.
- Check order status with the order ID and report it back.
- Download the delivered MP4 from the status page link when the user
  asks.

## What only the human must do

- Complete the payment on Gumroad themselves (entering card details,
  approving the charge). Never pay on a user's behalf.
- Choose and provide the photo (or photos) — their own photos, or
  photos they have the subject's permission to use.
- Confirm the scene choice; it cannot be changed once production
  starts.

## Safety lines — never break these

- The license key belongs to one purchase. Use it only to activate
  that buyer's own order on this site. Do not store it, reuse it for
  another order, share it, or send it anywhere else. The site itself
  keeps only its last 4 characters.
- Photos are private. Upload only the photos the user explicitly
  chose for this order. Never copy, retain, post, or reuse a person's
  photo for anything else. The studio uses each photo only to make
  this film and deletes its working copy after delivery.
- Never invent order IDs, license keys, delivery times, scene names,
  or status values. If the status page does not show it, it has not
  happened.

## Facts an agent can rely on

- Prices are $12.99 (Solo) and $19.99 (Duo); the soundtrack is
  included, not an upsell.
- Format is fixed: vertical MP4, 1080×1920, 8–10 seconds, with music.
- One scene per film; the six scenes are the ones listed above.
- Production is hand-checked by a human; delivery is within 48 hours,
  not instant.
- Support: binbin7418@gmail.com (replies within one business day).
